title: ANDS Studio — Validation & eCTD export
walkthrough:
The "Draft completeness check" card carries this flow. Its header reads "Draft completeness check" with a status chip on the right — "● NO STRUCTURAL ISSUES" when clean, or "● N issue(s)" (the error count) when errors exist. Below it the profile name and version show on the face, e.g. the criteria name followed by "v1.0" and, inline, "(structural; not HC eValidator)", then a one-line disclaimer. Two ghost buttons sit under it: "What this does / does NOT check" (expanding into "Modeled on…", a "Checks (structure & format)" list and a "Does NOT check" list) and "Rule catalogue (CA-E/CA-W ids)", which loads the live rule list grouped by family — each id like CA-E-1001 (warnings tagged "(warning)") with a plain description. A compact eCTD primer follows.

Findings are listed next. Each row shows a rule id, an "error" or "warning" chip, the failing leaf, and the message. Only the first 5 errors and 3 warnings appear, with a "Show all N findings" / "Show fewer" toggle and a "+N more warning(s)" note. When nothing is wrong you see "No presence/format issues found. This does not confirm scientific adequacy or full eCTD validity — run eValidator before transmission." A quiet "Technical check & report" expander reveals "Run technical check (PDF header/encryption)" (shows "Checking…" while it runs) and "Download report (CSV)" / "(JSON)" buttons, plus a footnote that this is a presence/format check, not a Health Canada review, and any checksum shown is document control (md5), not validation.

The "Application Viewer" page gives a read-only view of the assembled eCTD. A "Files" / "Outline" tab bar sits at the top with a "⬇ Export eCTD package" chip on the right. Files lists each Canadian Module folder with its placed documents (📄 icon, title, then "href · md5 …"), plus a live-leaf and placement-version line; empty, it reads "No documents placed yet." Outline shows the sequence, its lifecycle-operation count, the operations by operator and leaf, and an expandable "eCTD backbone (index.xml)". Clicking export runs the check first: on success the zip downloads; if it fails, a red banner explains "Export blocked — the completeness check did not pass," names the issue count, and points you to fix the module pages or override with a typed reason from the Sequences panel.

The "Sequences" card (with a "working: NNNN" note) lists each sequence: its number, a purpose chip (Response, Supplement, Annual notification, Initial), a "N leaf(s)" count, an "● ACTIVE" badge or "Make active" button, and an "Export" button. Lifecycle-operator chips ("2× new", "1× replace") appear per sequence when it has operations. "New sequence" opens a purpose dropdown, a note field (placeholder "Note (e.g. screening deficiency SDN-1)"), and "Create & make active" / "Cancel". On an export block, an "Export blocked — sequence NNNN" panel opens stating the reason, the profile checked, and up to 8 findings by rule id. "Export anyway (override)" stays disabled until you type a reason into "recorded to the audit trail"; then you export or "Cancel".
